targets.authors: Baratz KH, Tosakulwong N, Ryu E, et al.
targets.title: E2–2 protein and Fuchs's corneal dystrophy.
targets.evidence_quote: Recently, Baratz et al. 19 reported rs613872 associated with late-onset FCD. We report the first independent replication of the association study implicating rs613872 in the pathogenicity of late-onset FCD in our cohort of 350 subjects of Northern European descent.
targets.outcome_quote: We report the first independent replication of the association study implicating rs613872 in the pathogenicity of late-onset FCD in our cohort of 350 subjects of Northern European descent.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly report independent replication of the central risk association. Additional genetic-localization analyses address its independence from FCD2.
